class_imbalance_effects.summary: The LCZ dataset is class-imbalanced across built-environment and land-cover categories, so macro metrics are more informative than raw accuracy. Minority classes can be underrepresented in training and therefore show lower recall and F1 despite good overall accuracy.

limitations: Only one epoch was executed in the saved training run, so the model is a lightweight baseline rather than a fully converged classifier.
The input patches are 32x32, so the model is limited to local spatial context and does not explicitly model broader scene context.
The dataset contains known class imbalance across LCZ categories, which influences per-class performance and macro averages.
Model quality is partially constrained by the single-epoch baseline training configuration used in this isolated experiment.
